name: Karmly
description:
The Karmly connector lets your AI assistant answer questions about your Karmly recruitment and contractor data in a conversation.

You can ask about consultants and their profiles, hours and pay, billing and invoices, expenses, cashflow, account balances, and profitability. For example, "who are my top-billing consultants this month?" or "what's our profitability this quarter?" — and get an answer from your live Karmly data.

It's read-only, the assistant can look information up, but can't create, change, or delete anything in Karmly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Karmly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Karmly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://publicapi.karmly.com/karmly-public-api-mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Karmly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Karmly provides these MCP tools: getAccountBalances, getAccountTransactions, getBilling, getCashflow, getConsultants, getExpenses, getHoursSummary, getInvoiceCharges, getPaySummary, getPersonProfile, and getProfitability.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Karmly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Karmly in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Karmly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Karmly is developed by FlexiTime. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
